senses.gloss: (denom. of √דח, v. דְּחַהּ; cmp. בִּזְרָא) to be cheerful.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 18:9">Targ. Y. Ex. XVIII, 9</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 30b:21">Ber. 30ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ב׳ טובא</he> was very cheerful.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 17a:7">M. Kat. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>בְּדִיחָא דעתאי</he> I feel happy.

<cite ref="Shabbat 77b:8">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite>.—*<cite ref="Chullin 32a:7">Ḥull. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>לא הוה בדיחנא ביה וכ׳</he> I could not make light of my uncle so as to ask him (Ar. ed. pr. <he>בדיקנא</he>).
<cite ref="Nedarim 51a">Ned. 51ᵃ</cite> have I not cautioned thee <he>דלא תבדחן</he> not to make us laugh? <cite ref="Nedarim 50b:11">Ib. 50ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>תבדיחן</he> (En Yaak. <he>תבדחן</he>).
